thread:
Ava: Heads up — EU-west GPU pool is having aggressive OOMs, autoscaler retries are failing, and hosted-generation P99 is up ~3x. I'm going to apply temporary per-customer caps to stop noisy tenants from collapsing the pool. Creating thread so infra + support aware.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-4512 (severity: high) — paging infra-oncall. :rotating_light:
Mateo: Which customers are the biggest contributors to the surge? can we target just them rather than a blanket cap?
Priya: Top contributors in the last 10m by token/s:
```
- cust-A (platform): 420 t/s, large seq models
- cust-B (adtech): 220 t/s, many short chats
- cust-C (research): 150 t/s, long context runs
- many small orgs < 20 t/s each
```
Jun: Can we run soft caps at the edge first? prefer graceful shedding over pod evictions. If that isn't enough, hit application-level quotas.
infra-oncall: I'll push edge softcaps now — using rate-limiter v2. Plan: 1) Apply soft RPS caps for top-3 customers, 2) Enable route-weight fallback to us-east for small-models, 3) Block any new long-context sessions >8k tokens.
infra-oncall: Command: `redwoodctl quota set --customer cust-A --rps 10 --type soft --ttl 30m`
infra-oncall: Command: `redwoodctl quota set --customer cust-B --rps 7 --type soft --ttl 30m`
infra-oncall: Command: `redwoodctl quota set --customer cust-C --rps 5 --type soft --ttl 30m`
Samira: Notifying support & sales with the impacted customer list and mitigation steps. Linking docs for opt-out/whitelist requests.
Mateo: Can we avoid cross-region failovers? cross-region traffic has auth/e2e test risk.
Ava: We prefer avoiding cross-region but autoscaler cannot provision more gpus — cloud quotas exhausted in eu-west (spot pool evictions up). We'll do selective failover for low-risk routes only (small models & non-enterprise customers).
Ava: Command to add route fallback (50% weight for small models): `routes set --from eu-west --to us-east --filter "model.size:small AND not customer in (cust-A,cust-B,cust-C)" --weight 50 --ttl 20m`
Kevin: Heads-up on cost — if we push 50% traffic to us-east, estimate extra billing ~ +18-25% for the window (egress + premium runtime). If this runs >2h we need exec sign-off.
Priya: I'll ping product & finance now.
ops-bot: Quotas applied; metrics pipelines updated.
infra-oncall: Edge accepts reduced request rate; backend pods still showing queueing but degrading slower. Error rate for generation routes is down from 11% -> 3% after caps.
Jun: I'll keep an eye on autoscaler logs for provisioning errors and post stack traces if we see new OOM patterns.
Samira: Support message sent to impacted customers with mitigation details and expected TTL (30m). Offering temporary whitelist for enterprise customers after manual review.
Ava: Monitoring dashboard -> if error rate climbs above 5% or latency P95 > 2s we'll escalate to expand caps/evacuate evicted pods. Next check in 10 minutes.
Mateo: If we need more capacity long-term, ops plan: request regional quota bump + pre-warm dedicated reserved nodes for high-usage tenants.
infra-oncall: Recorded actions: applied soft caps, enabled routing fallback for small models, blocked long-context sessions >8k, notified support. Will revert or tune at 1839012700 unless we extend.
Jun: Logging note: saved rate-limiter diffs and pod eviction traces to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/INC-4512/
Ava: Thanks — team, stand down but stay ready. If anyone sees a regression, @infra-oncall please reopen thread. :thumbsup:
summary: Applied temporary soft per-customer RPS caps and selective cross-region fallback due to EU-west GPU pool instability; notified customers and support; monitoring for 30m TTL
